import "math"

speed = from(bucket: "weather")
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "weather_station" and r._field == "wind_speed_mph")
  |> last()
  |> keep(columns: ["_time", "_value"])
  |> rename(columns: {_value: "speed"})

dir = from(bucket: "weather")
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "weather_station" and r._field == "wind_dir_deg")
  |> last()
  |> keep(columns: ["_time", "_value"])
  |> rename(columns: {_value: "deg"})

join(tables: {speed: speed, dir: dir}, on: ["_time"])
  |> map(fn: (r) => {
      cardinal = if r.deg >= 337.5 or r.deg < 22.5 then "N"
        else if r.deg < 67.5 then "NE"
        else if r.deg < 112.5 then "E"
        else if r.deg < 157.5 then "SE"
        else if r.deg < 202.5 then "S"
        else if r.deg < 247.5 then "SW"
        else if r.deg < 292.5 then "W"
        else "NW"
      return {_time: r._time, label: string(v: int(v: math.round(x: r.speed))) + " mph " + cardinal}
  })

bucket = if spanNs <= 86400000000000 then 1h

  else if spanNs <= 2678400000000000 then 1d
  else if spanNs <= 15552000000000000 then 1w
